articles.author: William Judd
articles.title: Sony announces QSSR AI upscaling tech for base PS5 in Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei - Digital Foundry
articles.description: The PS5 Pro is no longer the sole domain of AI upscaling tech on console.
articles.content: Sony has announced QSSR - Quick Spectral Super Resolution - bringing PSSR-style AI upscaling to the base PS5 in a huge coup for existing console owners. Games need to be updated to add support for QS… [+2969 chars]
